election: Election of the Federal Chancellor by the Federal Assembly (United Federal Assembly)
opponent: Gabriel Lüchinger (SVP, 103 votes in 2nd ballot); also candidates Nathalie Goumaz (SVP) and independent Lukas Gresch-Brunner
detail: Succeeded Walter Thurnherr (Centre/Mitte). Rossi reached an absolute majority in the second ballot. First Federal Chancellor from the Green Liberal Party.

election: Election of the Vice-Chancellor by the Federal Council
detail: The Federal Council elected Rossi Vice-Chancellor in December 2018; he succeeded Jörg De Bernardi and led the Federal Council division of the Chancellery.
